messages.subject: Bracken v Calderwood – disclosure deadline next Friday
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Quick one on the Calderwood litigation (WC-00104, claim CL-2025-000412) – the extended deadline for exchange of disclosure lists is next Friday. Counsel (Rosenthal KC) wants a call before we finalise the disclosure index. I'll circulate the latest schedule tomorrow; can you do 4pm Wednesday?

Tom
